input.quote: 20. INDEMNIFICATION 20.1 Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services.
input.rationale: Section 20 contains only a one-way Customer indemnity covering "every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services", with no Vendor indemnity for third-party IP infringement or misconduct anywhere in the Agreement (Section 9.3 even cross-refers to a non-existent Section 20.5 of infringement remedies). That is walk-away territory under INDEMN and fails the fallback outright. We therefore added a Vendor defence/indemnity at the preferred level (IP infringement of Services or Deliverables, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused Customer Data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) with notice, control-of-defence and cooperation, and narrowed our own indemnity to Customer-provided content and our breach of Applicable Law. We did not adopt the fallback 3x-annual-fees super-cap because Section 21.3 already treats indemnification obligations as Excluded Claims and volunteering a cap would weaken us; the dangling Section 20.5 reference in Section 9.3 pre-exists and should be conformed in the next turn.

proposal.summary: Add Vendor defence/indemnity for IP, legal breach, data breach and wilful misconduct with standard procedure, and narrow Customer's indemnity.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 20 currently gives Vendor a one-way indemnity for every claim touching our use of the Services and no Vendor indemnity at all, so we added Vendor's defence and indemnity for third-party IP, legal-breach, data-breach and wilful-misconduct claims with the usual notice, control and cooperation procedure, and narrowed our indemnity to Customer-provided content and our breach of Applicable Law.

ops.oldText: from every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services.
ops.newText: from third-party claims to the extent arising out of Customer-provided content or Customer's breach of Applicable Law.

ops.text: Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer and its Affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs, and expenses, to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate an intellectual property right; (b) Vendor's breach of Applicable Law; (c) unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor; or (d) Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. Customer shall give Vendor prompt written notice of the claim, Vendor shall control the defence, and Customer shall provide reasonable cooperation.

mappings.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
